name: Starting Village
description: A small frontier settlement near the dungeon entrance. Three years after the Fracture, it survives on dungeon salvage and passing adventurers.

name: The Dungeon - Floor 1
description: The uppermost level of the dungeon beneath the village. Goblins, wolves, and scavengers make this their territory.

name: Crystal Caverns
description: Second floor of the dungeon. Void-crystals pulse with captured System energy. The air smells of ozone and something older.

name: Fracture Core
description: The deepest accessible point of the dungeon. The origin of the Fracture itself. Reality is thin here.

name: The Deep
description: Unmapped depths below the Fracture Core. Only the desperate or the powerful go here.

name: City of Verath
description: The capital of Aethoria. Center of System governance, guild politics, and faction intrigue since the Fracture.

name: Market District
description: The trade heart of Verath. Auction houses, merchants, and the Golden Scales Trading Co. operate here.

name: Mages Spire
description: Headquarters of the Mages Conclave. Towers of arcane research, System study, and forbidden knowledge.

name: The Undermarket
description: The grey-market district beneath Verath. The Iron Hammer Exchange operates in the shadows here.

name: Palace District
description: Seat of the Verath Crown. Heavily guarded. Entry requires standing or Crown credentials.
